NAME:          Automate Enforcement
STATEMENT:     Checkable rules must be enforced by a running system, not manual review alone
RATIONALE:     Manual enforcement doesn't scale and silently degrades as the org grows
IMPLICATIONS:  New policies must be expressible as code (Ch.4) or flagged as a known gap
